I don't have any notes on Ezekiel 30 for you yet, because I couldn't get any source pages to load in this session.

I tried to fetch six pages at once: Enduring Word, Ellicott, Gill and the Pulpit Commentary on biblehub.com, Precept Austin, and the NET Bible notes. Before I could check what came back, a bug in my script stopped the run. After that the tool wouldn't let me make any more calls this turn, so I never read any of the pages.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge, so I haven't written any verse notes. Anything I wrote now would be unsourced.

If you ask again, I'll start with those six sources and add other sites only where they bear on a verse:
- **Traditional verse-by-verse reading:** the six pages above.
- **Where Protestant traditions differ:** Spurgeon, Desiring God, Ligonier, Wesley Center and similar sites. I'll include these only where they actually discuss Ezekiel 30.
- **Other views:** the NET Bible notes on names like Put, Lud, "the covenant land," Pathros, Zoan and Pi-beseth, and the date in v. 20. Also Catholic and Orthodox material from newadvent.org (for example, Haydock or Church Fathers references), if any exists for this chapter.

I'll write the notes verse by verse with a URL for each point, and leave out anything I can't find.
